source.citation: Lonial S, Waller EK, Richardson PG, et al. Risk factors and kinetics of thrombocytopenia associated with bortezomib for relapsed, refractory multiple myeloma. Blood. 2005;106(12):3777-3784.
source.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer only; not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted from the PDF text layer; page numbers refer to the PMC printout.

population.regimen: 1.3 mg/m2 IV days 1, 4, 8, 11 of 21-day cycles, up to 8 cycles; doses withheld or reduced for toxicity
population.platelet_sampling: Before bortezomib on days 1, 4, 8 and 11 of each cycle

relationship_to_model: Same source used to fit Lignet 2022 (via digitised Figure 2). A reproduction check against it is an internal consistency check, not external validation.

values.quote: The mean baseline platelet count was 165 × 109/L (SD 91.3)

values.statistic: mean of patient values on cycle 1 day 11 (before that day's dose)
values.quote: the mean cycle 1 day 11 platelet count was 107 × 109/L (SD 65.7)
an approximately 60% reduction in platelet counts from start to nadir
values.comparability: Not comparable with a typical-value curve: individual nadirs fall on different days, so their mean exceeds the dip of the mean curve.

values.quote: decreasing during the portion of the cycle when bortezomib was administered and recovering to baseline during the rest periods of each cycle

cycle1_day11_over_baseline.note: Ratio of means, not mean of ratios.

not_extracted: Figure 2 (mean platelet count by cycle day with standard errors) is an image; values were not digitised.
